svg.title: ResumeLens: from a resume to traceable qualification patterns
svg.desc: Complete research poster with a worked example, regex evidence, FST path, four epsilon-NFA patterns, textX candidate language, separate synthetic evaluation results and verification limits.

From a resume to traceable qualification patterns.

svg.text: Candidate data, spans, links, profiles and exports.
Windows regression; source spans and files checked.
Bounded retries handle transient Windows file locks.
A positive Python claim can be missed.
Job requirements can be mistaken for skills.
Bounded context misses some technical prose.
Next: independent real data and profile-domain validation.
Complete machines: docs/models/ and docs/automata/ | EBNF: docs/candidate-language.md | Evaluation: data/
Mohri (1997), Computational Linguistics 23(2), 269-311. Yu, Guan & Zhou (2005), ACL, 499-506. doi:10.3115/1219840.1219902
Synthetic regression, not population accuracy. Structure does not verify claims. No ranking or hiring decision is inferred.
